Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As we discussed, Brightline's renewal window gives us a good opportunity to phase a throughput uplift across three tiers (pilot canary -> dedicated pool -> full capacity) rather than a single-step commit. That approach should reduce risk and give you measurable headroom before the new term starts.

Proposed next steps: 
- Confirm stakeholders on your side (technical + procurement + exec owner) 
- Share a 30-day mutual action plan (attached) and a runbook for the canary test
- Lock a QBR slot to review usage patterns and pricing impact before finalizing terms

Suggested QBR windows (pick two preferred slots):
- Jan 4–8, 2027 (morning PT / afternoon ET)
- Jan 11–15, 2027 (mid-week preferred for execs)

I've attached a draft mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx and last month's usage export so we can baseline throughput needs. I'll loop in Markus from Legal once we have an initial timeline so we can fast-track any redlines.

If you want, we can run a 48–72 hour dedicated pool canary to validate throughput before committing to a 12-month term change.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation on stakeholders and your preferred QBR slot.
